statement: For every pair of completed pro-3 Kummer classes, the inherited cubic class-two section fibre has exactly three classes precisely when its explicit central corrections c_q=-9(A_q b_q-B_q a_q)/(q-1) are integral and tend to zero over the primes q other than3; otherwise it is empty. Continuous H2 is the actual quotient R/diag(q-1)R. An explicit completed pair has all local and finite-coefficient obstructions zero but a nonzero global continuous obstruction.
notes: The proof takes the filtered direct limit of finite-support localization triangles at each coefficient level before the derived inverse limit. Each term of the residue-field two-term complex has surjective coefficient transitions, giving the exact restricted-sequence complex. H2 and H3 over Spec Z[1/3] vanish by an explicit Euler-characteristic calculation and odd-order real-place vanishing. The cup representative is computed at chain level from the central-zero inertia splitting and Frobenius defect, so phantom classes are retained. Code checks7200 tame relations,7200 coboundary/Frobenius changes,6000 cocycle signs,6000 coefficient transitions,40000 independent rational tame comparisons, and10 explicit prime/exponent pairs in the infinite witness. This is a complete inherited-class-two classification; the intrinsic quotient maps to it through(E.29e) and retains the independent E.31 obstruction. Independent mathematical audit by bc_fermat found no gap.
